model3.stoppingRule: No further Model3 starts after the latest stopping instruction. Its then-current owned game was resolved naturally as a win.
model3.freshStartAfterDiagnosticLoss: Earlier delegation explicitly requested a fresh uninterrupted qualification after separately reporting diagnostic outcomes. The later stopping instruction superseded that plan.
model3.abandonedStarts: The first two stalled diagnostic games were left using the normal client concession action. They are retained as driver-aborted starts, not natural policy losses.

observedLoss.lastDecisions: Recon Directive and End turn; no attack or retreat was offered in the final decisions.
observedLoss.interpretation: Consistent with deck-out. Exact exported end-reason text was not captured.

sharedPolicy.attribution: Setup/text helpers and the frozen native teacher handle unsupported neural prompt domains, including blind prizes, empty choices and damage allocation. Do not credit these choices to the actor.

timingDefinition: Game wall time includes client animation, AI and rate-limit waits. Driver RPC request wall time and model inference wall time are separately measured; neither is the whole game wall time. Model3 repair timing is incomplete and its wall times include repairs. Both Model4 games have single uninterrupted timing sessions.
validation: Actual official-client AI games only, with startup model/schema/hash checks. No test suites or training were run for these qualification attempts.
publicProjection: Local game identifiers were replaced with per-candidate chronological ordinals. Driver/helper pins describe the original qualification source; the public integration replaces private paths with ignored local configuration and synchronizes admitted-action metadata. No qualification was rerun after these publication changes.
